% Display math with two pictures and math between them, or a picture in
% each row, stays MathJax's: TeX would set the math between the pictures
% as text. The config defines \tikz and \draw for MathJax.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{amsmath}
\usepackage{tikz}
\begin{document}
Two diagrams.
$$ \tikz{\draw (0,0) -- (1,0);} \cong \tikz{\draw (0,0) -- (1,1);} $$

Two rows.
\begin{align}
\tikz{\draw (0,0) -- (1,0);} \\
\tikz{\draw (0,0) -- (1,1);}
\end{align}
\end{document}
